description: This file contains unit tests for the class DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLogger, testing logging behavior, MDC entries, and their cleanup in various scenarios.

classes.name: DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLoggerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLogger, verifying logging and MDC behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes MDC observer and registers it with ObservableMdcAdapter before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Deregisters MDC observer after each test.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Tests that creating logger instance with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the logger name matches the underlying Logger's name.

methods.name: logInfoWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Checks logging with a correlation ID sets the MDC correctly, then logs info.

methods.name: putNothingToMdcAndDoNotLogAsInfoIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that if info logging is disabled, no MDC entries are put and no log is made.

methods.name: logDebugAndWarnWithTwoMdcValuesThenClose
methods.description: Tests that debug and warn logs with MDC entries are correctly emitted and MDC is cleaned up on close.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaKey
methods.description: Tests removing MDC entry via key updates MDC correctly.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaNullValue
methods.description: Tests that setting MDC entry to null removes the key from MDC.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Helper method returning the current test method name as correlation ID.
